notes.title: Battle Titan RAINBOW – August Development Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]📢 Battle Titan RAINBOW – 8.Development Update[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]Hello everyone, this is [i]Pola.[/i] with another Bi-monthly Dev-Log.
As the game grows in scale, new challenges have appeared, but progress continues steadily.[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="nJg6s0ZnWtA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Development - video ( 3 m 30 s)  - Please raise the resolution to 1080p.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🚀 Major Updates[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/8687e6583fe0ad65dd3260763e9c94f767626421.jpg"][/img][/p][p]BTR : Development Diary 21. - \[Details: English][/p][p]\[ A detailed development journal on the progress of the development. ][/p][p][url="https://blog.naver.com/yuolden00/223988180444"]DevDiaty_Link [/url][/p][h3][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/5843bfcdd4ecfb2306c9718d5ba93ca288d0a29e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🏁 Final Stage Design Begins[/h3][list][*][p]Structured in 3 parts: [b]Stratosphere Re-entry → Fortress Assault → Interior Battle[/b][/p][/*][*][p]About [b]15 minutes of playtime[/b], roughly double a normal stage[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/77ba1cdfe974ce52ffba0ba6e3234dc77f924e8d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🌵 Stage 5 Desert STAGE - Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Added sandstorms, lighting effects, and atmosphere enhancements[/p][/*][*][p]Visual upgrades without disrupting game play[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/3eba74fc1984f489a48b38b151555a83f28ece94.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][h3]🎥 VFX & Camera Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p]Zoom blur, motion blur, and UI alpha blending[/p][/*][*][p]Retro shooter feel with modern cinematic effects[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/c45e8143f6cc2b71abe21f98a44538689bd2a1b4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🤖 Mecha - notes.title: BattleTitan RAINBOW – Dev Update (May 2025)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/0f3e66b51fee5d1fd71b09faaf3e0aac52951804.png[/img]
BattleTitan RAINBOW – Dev Update (May 2025)[b]
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/e81f2f1fc42cbfb35504be453c8a58bd4bd486b0.jpg[/img]
[b]Steam Deck Testing Initiated[/b]
CPU and GPU usage around 30%. Steam Deck surprisingly powerful, running smoother than low-end laptops with integrated GPUs.

[b]Menu Development[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/71055c493e3f6597658a145b56bd508a053c7cad.jpg[/img]
[b]A. Start Screen[/b]
Three types of start screens configured. Currently in development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/d77c9a7d2ce55f43d4302143530ad0f50a03a877.jpg[/img]
[b]B. Gallery Mode[/b]
Organized to allow browsing of characters, mechanics, and events from the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/2903202f86c25122b5a3cedaefce17f7fcafb79e.jpg[/img]
[b]C. Ranking Screen[/b]
Currently, Demo doesn't support Steam leaderboards; local leaderboard operational.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/aa0c9ad4720395a9bd9d3dadd33accbe6859255f.jpg[/img]
[b]D. Name Entry Screen[/b]
Allows players to change initials for leaderboard records. Designed with retro arcade game aesthetics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/229b596b749c8af83370d5203ca6a0685af16157.jpg[/img]
[b]E. Input Key Configuration[/b]
Implemented customizable key mapping. The process was unexpectedly complex, highlighting why many indie games don't support this feature.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/fb7278017d1a8f4d6595d1104ccbac8d0efdfa14.jpg[/img]
[b]Extra Language Support[/b]
Final language option [Extra] defaults to English, but players can modify CSV files to change languages freely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/cc0ab96aaedf23e6db9dd10152188afff7ccb53b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/ee624d43a713d48de9fae920eb5d9a0cd17a8b1b.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/56b618860cd683f598c642d44344d99352377cb7.jpg[/img]

[b]Event [Artwork] Development Ongoing[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/a4a6244a8ddfed1fb0acca1135608a7d6b0b21eb.jpg[/img]
[b]Developing the final Demo build during May[/b]
Includes Arcade 1, Story 1, and Boss Match 1 modes.

notes.title: Battle Titan RAINBOW Dev 1. 2025. 4. 4 Week
notes.content:
[b]Battle Titan RAINBOW Dev.[/b]
We’d like to share the changes made to the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/10ae6db530a2ef337d88d59d3425b06eba0d95e4.jpg[/img]
[u][b]Game Genre[/b][/u]
Previously, the game had RPG-like mechanics with levels, stats, gear, and various options, only the combat was STG-based. This required extensive development in balance, graphics, and design.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/2f42ac3227dffcf0d40cb20175513580af60dd19.jpg[/img]
Now, the game is purely a Shm-up [STG], where each player selects characters with unique weapons and traits. We've streamlined choices to help players quickly enter gameplay and focus on combat.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/697ebef3c4d3ba53ea79730e6bb54efff1fb5add.jpg[/img]
[u][b]Battle Stage[/b][/u]
There are 7 themed stages with 3 game modes:
ARCADE: Quick gameplay with short battles.
JOURNEY: Long gameplay based on 7 episodes.
MATCH: 1 vs 1 Boss battles.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/f5080924134c7d4ddb4d6b0975f5033aae8ae5f0.jpg[/img]
[u][b]Boss Type[/b][/u]
Bosses range from bullet-hell to fighting-game styles. JOURNEY has the highest difficulty and multiple phases. You can CONTINUE after Game Over in JOURNEY mode.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/51bb129569321c35cc170098367105a1179a5b1a.jpg[/img]
[u][b]Story[/b][/u]
Previously set over a year-long road-movie style narrative, now it focuses on a "7-day event" air operation.


[u]"The protagonist is the heir of a martial arts sect defeated by enemy forces. Driven by personal vengeance and to restore honor, they fight alongside allies using the cursed mech (RAINBOW), awakened from its seal."[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/e40a1f7cb8e1faa25cc980b830fd1a0f0768292a.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Detailed lore can be accessed via the Gallery menu. 
[*] It blends SF martial arts with classic super robot anime tropes,
[*]  featuring a mix of super and real robot designs.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/23f1284561bbdf995038a3fe0c287b5957fcd77c.jpg[/img]
Boss Concept:  Battle Titan - Silver Wind[img]

notes.title: Battle Titan RAINBOW Dev. [2025-1Q]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/f469e28e1177ab91fc732022c240b3aa1485fb4d.jpg[/img]
[h2]Battle Titan RAINBOW Dev. [1Q-2025][/h2]

[h3]Hello,
 I am the developer of Battle Titan RAINBOW.
It has been 1,151 days since the first demo was uploaded. During this time, 
I was unable to update the Steam page with new information about the game. 
Due to various challenges, progress was delayed, but development has continued, and I am now able to share an update.[/h3]

[olist]
[*] The game is still in development. 
[*] As a solo developer working part-time while managing other responsibilities, 
     progress has been steady. 
[*] The genre has shifted from RPG to SHM-UP, focusing on a more streamlined 
     development process to bring an early access version as soon as possible.
[*] A new demo, different from the currently uploaded version,
    is planned for release between May and June.
[*] Localization efforts are underway, but as I am not a native speaker, 
     some translations may contain errors. I appreciate your understanding.
[*] I will continue to share development updates at intervals of one week to one month.
    You can find the latest development progress at the link below.
[/olist]
